set.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch

set.name: Elbows Back

Place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward and elbows out.

Skip by executing a step-hop pattern of right-right-step to left-left-step, and so on, alternating back and forth.

Begin by jumping with both feet over the first cone, swinging both arms as you jump.

set.name: Front Leg Raises

Swing your leg forward, keeping the leg straight.

set.name: Hamstring Stretch

Pull on the belt to create tension in the calves and hamstrings.

set.name: Hip Circles (prone)

Keeping the knee in a bent position, rotate the femur in an arc, attempting to make a big circle with your knee.

set.name: Hug Knees To Chest

Hold your arms under the knees, not over (that would put to much pressure on your knee joints).

set.name: Hurdle Hops

Begin by jumping with both feet over the first hurdle, swinging both arms as you jump.

set.name: Inchworm

Begin by walking your hands forward slowly, alternating your left and your right.

set.name: Isometric Chest Squeezes

Hold for the recommended number of seconds.

set.name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back

Hold for the recommended number of seconds.

set.name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Sides
captions: Now gently push towards the left as you contract the left neck muscles but resisting any movement of your head.
Hold for the recommended number of seconds.

set.name: Isometric Wipers

set.name: Jackknife Sit-Up

set.name: Janda Sit-Up

set.name: Knee Across The Body

Place your left arm comfortably beside you and turn your head to the left.

set.name: Knee Circles
captions: Stand with your legs together and hands by your waist.
Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally.

set.name: Knee Tuck Jump
captions: Begin in a comfortable standing position with your knees slightly bent.
Rapidly dip down into a quarter squat and immediately explode upward.

set.name: Kneeling Arm Drill

Begin by blocking the arms in long, pendulum like swings.

set.name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
captions: Start by kneeling on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing back toward your knees.
Slowly lean back keeping your palms flat on the floor until you feel a stretch in your wrists and forearms.

set.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor
captions: Kneel on a mat and bring your right knee up so the bottom of your foot is on the floor
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in your hip.

set.name: Lateral Bound

Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift your weight to the outside leg.

set.name: Lateral Cone Hops

set.name: Leg Lift

set.name: Leg Pull-In

Bend your knees and pull your upper thighs into your midsection as you breathe out.

set.name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch

Extend the other leg in the air.

set.name: Linear 3-Part Start Technique

Place your right hand onto the line, and thing bring your nose close to your left knee.

set.name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill

Switch legs, raising the opposite knee, and then attacking the ground straight down.

set.name: Looking At Ceiling

Lift your buttocks up and forward while bringing your head back to look up at the ceiling, to give an arch in your back.

set.name: Lower Back Curl
captions: Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your sides.
Using your lower back muscles, extend your spine lifting your chest off of the ground.

set.name: Middle Back Stretch
captions: Stand so your feet are shoulder width apart and your hands are on your hips.
Twist at your waist until you feel a stretch.

set.name: Moving Claw Series

Reload the quad as the leg moves back forward, attacking the ground on the next step.

set.name: Oblique Crunches

Make sure your feet are elevated and resting on a flat surface.

set.name: Oblique Crunches - On The Floor
captions: Once you are in this set position, begin by moving your left elbow up
Crunch as high as you can, hold the contraction for a second and then slowly drop back down into the starting position.

set.name: On Your Side Quad Stretch
captions: Start off by lying on your right side

set.name: One Arm Against Wall

set.name: One Knee To Chest

Extend one leg straight and pull the other knee to your chest.

set.name: Overhead Stretch

set.name: Prone Manual Hamstring

set.name: Rear Leg Raises

Hold the pole behind your hips with a wider than shoulder width grip.

set.name: Runner's Stretch

Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

set.name: Scissor Kick

With a slight bend at the knees, lift your legs up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground.

set.name: Scissors Jump

Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot.

set.name: Seated Calf Stretch
captions: Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.

set.name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
captions: Sit on a mat with your right leg extended in front of you
Lean forward from your hips and reach for your ankle until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.

set.name: Seated Overhead Stretch
captions: Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Touch the soles of your feet together with your feet six to eight inches in front of your hips.

set.name: Shoulder Circles
captions: With shoulders relaxed and arms resting loosely at your sides (or in your lap if you're seated)
Reverse direction.

set.name: Shoulder Raise
captions: Relax your arms to your sides and raise your shoulders up toward your ears, then back down.

set.name: Shoulder Stretch
captions: Reach your left arm across your body and hold it straight.

set.name: Side Hop-Sprint
captions: Begin this drill by hopping sideways over the obstacle, rebounding out of your landing to hop back to where you started.
Hop for a prescribed number or repetitions as quickly as possible

set.name: Side Leg Raises
captions: Stand next to a chair, which you may hold onto as a support.
Keeping your leg straight, raise it as far out to the side as possible, and swing it back down

set.name: Side Lying Groin Stretch
captions: Start off by lying on your right side and bend your right knee in front of you to stabilize the torso.
Rest your head on your right hand or shoulder.

set.name: Side Neck Stretch
captions: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder.
Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.

set.name: Side Standing Long Jump
captions: Begin standing with your feet hip width apart in an athletic stance.
Leaning to your right, extend through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump into the air.

set.name: Side Wrist Pull
captions: This stretch works best standing.
Slowly straighten, pull, and lift it up to shoulder height, as pictured.

set.name: Side-Lying Floor Stretch
captions: First lie on your left side
Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind your left.

set.name: Single Leg Butt Kick
captions: Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised.
Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg.

set.name: Single-Cone Sprint Drill
captions: This drill teaches quick foot action.
Chop the feet as quickly as possible, blocking with the arms.

set.name: Single-Leg Hop Progression
captions: Arrange a line of cones in front of you.
Hop forward, jumping and landing with the same leg over the cone.

set.name: Single-Leg Lateral Hop
captions: Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle.
To begin, execute a counterjump to hop sideways over the cone.

set.name: Sit Squats
captions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips.

set.name: Spider Crawl
captions: Begin in a prone position on the floor.
Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground.

set.name: Split Jump
captions: Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground.
Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot.

set.name: Standing Biceps Stretch
captions: Clasp your hands behind your back with your palms together, straighten arms
Raise your arms up and hold until you feel a stretch in your biceps.

set.name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch
captions: Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot.
Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight.

set.name: Standing Hip Circles
captions: Begin standing on one leg, holding to a vertical support.
Raise the unsupported knee to 90 degrees.

set.name: Standing Hip Flexors
captions: Stand up straight with the spine vertical, the left foot slightly in front of the right.
Bend both knees and lift the back heel off the floor as you press the right hip forward.

set.name: Standing Lateral Stretch
captions: Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent.
Place your right hand on your right hip to support the spine.

set.name: Standing Long Jump
captions: This drill is best done in sand or other soft landing surface.
Utilizing a big arm swing and a countermovement of the legs, jump forward as far as you can.

set.name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
captions: Start off with your feet hip-distance apart.
Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.

set.name: Standing Soleus And Achilles Stretch
captions: Stand with your feet hip-distance apart, one foot slightly in front of the other.
Bend both knees, keeping your back heel on the floor.

set.name: Standing Toe Touches
captions: Stand with some space in front and behind you.
Bend at the waist, keeping your legs straight, until you can relax and let your upper body hang down in front of you.

set.name: Standing Towel Triceps Extension
captions: To begin, stand up with both arms fully extended above the head holding one end of a towel with both hands.
Now communicate with your partner so that he/she can grip the other side of the towel to apply resistance.

set.name: Star Jump
captions: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible.

set.name: Stomach Vacuum
captions: To begin, stand straight with your feet shoulder width apart from each other.
Now slowly inhale as much air as possible and then start to exhale as much as possible

set.name: The Straddle
captions: Begin in a seated, upright position.
With your hands on the floor, lean forward as far as possible.

set.name: Toe Touchers
captions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor.
Your legs should be touching each other.

set.name: Trail Running/Walking
captions: Running or hiking on trails will get the blood pumping and heart beating almost immediately.
A 150 lb person can burn over 200 calories for 30 minutes walking uphill, compared to 175 on a flat surface.

set.name: Tricep Side Stretch
captions: Bring right arm across your body and over your left shoulder, holding your elbow with your left hand

set.name: Triceps Stretch
captions: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull.

set.name: Tuck Crunch
captions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor.
Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other.

set.name: Upper Back Stretch
captions: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.

set.name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
captions: While seated, bend forward to hug your thighs from underneath with both arms.
Keep your knees together and your legs extended out as you bring your chest down to your knees.

set.name: Upward Stretch
captions: Extend both hands straight above your head, palms touching.
Slowly push your hands up and back, keeping your back straight.

set.name: Wrist Circles
captions: Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other.
Keeping your entire body stationary except for the wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion.

set.name: Adductor/Groin
captions: Have your partner hold your feet or ankles.
Attempt to squeeze your legs together for 10 or more seconds, while your partner prevents you from doing so.

set.name: All Fours Quad Stretch
captions: Start off on your hands and knees, then lift your leg off the floor and hold the foot with your hand.
Use your hand to hold the foot or ankle, keeping the knee fully flexed, stretching the quadriceps and hip flexors.

set.name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
captions: Place your hands behind your hand, and push your elbows back as far as you can.
Gently attempt to pull your elbows forward with your hands still behind your head for 10 or more seconds.

set.name: Body-Up
captions: Assume a plank position on the ground.
Pressing your palms firmly into the ground, extend through the elbows to raise your body from the ground.

set.name: Clock Push-Up
captions: Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width.
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering your chest toward the ground.

set.name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
captions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Perform a rear lunge by stepping back with one foot and flexing the hips and front knee.

set.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
captions: Begin on your knees with your upper legs and torso upright.
Lower yourself by extending at the knee, taking care to NOT flex the hips as you go forward.

set.name: Freehand Jump Squat
captions: Cross your arms over your chest.
With your head up and your back straight, position your feet at shoulder width.

set.name: Frog Hops
captions: Stand with your hands behind your head, and squat down keeping your torso upright and your head up.
Jump forward several feet, avoiding jumping unnecessarily high.

set.name: Frog Sit-Ups
captions: Now, cross your arms in front of you by touching the opposite shoulders.
As you exhale flatten your lower back to the floor while curling the torso upwards.

set.name: Groin and Back Stretch
captions: Interlock your fingers behind your head.
Curl downwards, bringing your elbows to the inside of your thighs.

set.name: Groiners
captions: Begin in a pushup position on the floor.
Using both legs, jump forward landing with your feet next to your hands.

set.name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
captions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull gently on the belt to create tension in your groin and hamstring muscles.

set.name: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
captions: Lie face down on the floor, with a rope, belt, or band looped around one foot.
Flex the knee and extend the hip of the leg to be stretched, using both hands to pull on the belt.

set.name: Iron Crosses (stretch)
captions: Lie face down on the floor, with your arms extended out to your side, palms pressed to the floor.
To begin, flex one knee and bring that leg across the back of your body

set.name: IT Band and Glute Stretch
captions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one of your feet, and swing that leg across your body to the opposite side
Keeping your foot off of the floor, pull on the belt, using the tension to pull the toes up.

set.name: Lying Bent Leg Groin
captions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the soles of the feet pressed together.
Attempt to squeeze your knees together, while your partner prevents any movement from occurring.

set.name: Lying Crossover
captions: Cross one leg over your body with the knee bent, attempting to touch the knee to the ground.
Attempt to raise the bent knee off of the ground as your partner prevents any actual movement.

set.name: Lying Glute
captions: Flex the hip of one leg, raising it off of the floor.
Attempt to push your leg towards your partner, who should be preventing any actual movement of the leg.

set.name: Lying Hamstring
captions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
With your partner holding your leg in place, attempt to flex the knee, contracting the hamstrings for 10-20 seconds.

set.name: Lying Prone Quadriceps
captions: Lay face down on the floor with your partner kneeling beside you.
Attempt to extend your knee while your partner prevents any actual movement.

set.name: Overhead Lat
captions: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you.
Attempt to pull your upper arm to your side as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.

set.name: Overhead Triceps
captions: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you.
Attempt to extend the arm straight into the air as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.

set.name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
captions: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back.

set.name: Peroneals Stretch
captions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted

set.name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
captions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted

set.name: Quad Stretch
captions: Lay on your side.
With the belt being held over the shoulder or overhead, gently pull to increase the stretch in the quadriceps.

set.name: Seated Biceps
captions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your partner standing behind you.
Attempt to flex your elbows, while your partner prevents any actual movement.

set.name: Seated Front Deltoid
captions: Sit upright on the floor with your legs bent, your partner standing behind you.
Keeping your elbows straight, attempt to move your arms to the front

set.name: Seated Glute
captions: In a seated position with your knees bent, cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.

set.name: Seated Hamstring
captions: In a seated position with your legs extended, have your partner stand behind you.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.

set.name: Seated Hamstring and Calf Stretch
captions: Loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot.
Leaning forward slightly, pull on the belt to draw the toes of your foot back.

set.name: Single-Arm Push-Up
captions: Begin laying prone on the ground.
Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back.

set.name: Windmills
captions: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and your legs straight.
Lift one leg and quickly cross it over your body, attempting to touch the ground near the opposite hand.

set.name: World's Greatest Stretch
captions: This is a three-part stretch.
Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot.
